clusters.headline: Polri Postpones Sidang Etik Listyo Sigit Amid Refusal To Attend
aiSummaryBullets: The Police Code of Ethics Commission postponed the trial of former Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo until November 30, 2026.
Officials stated there is no regulation allowing for the forced attendance of the former official at ethics proceedings.

clusters.headline: Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman Undergo Vice Presidential Health Tests
aiSummaryBullets: Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman are undergoing mandatory health examinations at the Gatot Soebroto Army Hospital.
The MPR verification team is cross-referencing administrative documents and test results for the vice presidential candidates.

clusters.headline: Thirteen Dead, Thirteen Missing at Illegal Gold Mine in Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: Thirteen miners have been confirmed dead, with thirteen more still missing following an accident at an illegal gold mine in Ciguha, Bogor.
Joint search and rescue teams are currently working to locate the remaining individuals despite facing significant operational challenges.

clusters.headline: Kejaksaan Agung Tugaskan 32 Jaksa Tangani Kasus Listyo Sigit Cs
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office has designated 32 prosecutors to oversee the legal files concerning former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
Bareskrim investigators identified a civilian suspect linked to the alleged illegal wiretapping operations conducted by Listyo Sigit and his associates.

clusters.headline: MPR Schedules Vice President Election For December 10 And 11, 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR Ad Hoc Committee proposed a two-day plenary session on December 10 and 11, 2026, to select a successor for the vacant Vice Presidency.
Verification teams are currently vetting two vice-presidential candidates by coordinating with the KPK, Supreme Court, Police, and Ministry of Finance.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Prepares To Face FC Seoul In AFC Champions League 2
aiSummaryBullets: Persib Bandung is preparing for their upcoming AFC Champions League 2 match against FC Seoul.
The club is currently evaluating scenarios to secure the top position in Group E.

clusters.headline: Harga Emas Antam Naik Rp2.000 Pada 24 November Jadi Rp2,507 Juta
aiSummaryBullets: Harga emas batangan Antam mencatat kenaikan tipis sebesar Rp2.000 pada perdagangan Selasa, 24 November 2026.
Nilai per gram emas Antam kini berada di angka Rp2,507 juta.

clusters.headline: Roy Suryo Questions Jokowi Diploma Details at Jakarta Court Trial
aiSummaryBullets: The legal team for defendant Roy Suryo questioned witnesses regarding discrepancies in font placement on academic documents attributed to former President Joko Widodo.
Arguments occurred in the East Jakarta District Court between defense counsel and public prosecutors during the examination of a university acquaintance of the former president.

clusters.headline: Jaksa Siapkan 142 Saksi dalam Sidang Korupsi Tambang Rp 17,7 Triliun
aiSummaryBullets: Jaksa telah mempersiapkan 142 saksi untuk memberikan keterangan dalam kasus korupsi pertambangan.
Kasus ini berkaitan dengan dugaan kerugian negara yang mencapai Rp 17,7 triliun.

clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Denies Vice President Bid Amid Prabowo Nomination Talk
aiSummaryBullets: Sufmi Dasco clarified he is not seeking the vice presidential role and was asked by President Prabowo Subianto to recommend two candidates instead.
Candidates Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono remain under public and official scrutiny, including tax compliance reviews, as potential successors.

clusters.headline: DVI Teams Identify Remains Following Massive Fire At PT FAM Cikande
aiSummaryBullets: Police forensic teams are accelerating DNA testing to identify remains recovered from the site of the factory fire.
Search efforts for dozens of missing individuals have been hindered by unstable building structures and adverse weather conditions.

clusters.headline: DKPP Gelar Sidang Dugaan Pelanggaran Etik KPU Soal Pencalonan Gibran
aiSummaryBullets: Detik reports: DKPP Gelar Sidang Dugaan Pelanggaran Etik KPU Soal Pencalonan Gibran
Okezone reports: DKPP Sidangkan Dugaan Pelanggaran Etik Ijazah Gibran, Pengadu Minta Ketua dan Anggota KPU Dipecat

clusters.headline: Government Opens 154,052 CPNS 2026 Positions Starting November 27
aiSummaryBullets: Registration for 154,052 central government CPNS positions begins November 27, 2026, and will close in early December.
Minister Rini Widyantini confirmed no regional government formations will be included in the 2026 recruitment process.

clusters.headline: KKP Sets 97.5 Million Hectare Marine Conservation Area Target By 2045
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries aims to designate 97.5 million hectares as marine conservation areas by 2045.
Minister Sakti Wahyu Trenggono emphasizes that spatial planning success is essential for ensuring long-term ocean health.

clusters.headline: BMKG Projects Rain Throughout Indonesia Amid Ongoing Weather Risks
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG forecasts light rain across the majority of Indonesian regions on Wednesday.
The Jabodetabek area is expected to experience light rainfall according to current meteorological projections.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Questions Kupang Regent Yosef Lede In Assault Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede has undergone questioning by police regarding ongoing allegations of sexual assault.
Police previously conducted a search of the regent's official residence, seizing several items as potential evidence for the investigation.

clusters.headline: Regional Governments and Officials Target Indonesia Economic Growth
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Home Affairs identified four core components essential for sustaining national economic momentum.
Regional administrations, including Jayapura, Central Java, and East Java, are launching local initiatives to stimulate economic development.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Discusses BTS Jakarta Concert With South Korean President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto met with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung at the ASEAN Summit to discuss the upcoming BTS concert in Jakarta.
The third day of the BTS performance in Indonesia will be broadcast live across 2,800 cinema screens in more than 80 countries.

clusters.headline: Kemenhut Tegaskan Ujung Kulon Tetap Menjadi Habitat Badak Jawa
aiSummaryBullets: Kementerian Kehutanan berkomitmen memperkuat konservasi badak jawa di Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon.
Pemerintah membantah akan mengeluarkan izin tambang meskipun terdapat potensi cadangan emas di wilayah tersebut.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Regions And Organizations Receive Multiple State Awards
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Home Affairs awarded regional administrations for excellence in Forkopimda performance and administrative population documentation.
Specific regions including NTB, Surabaya, Tangerang, Surakarta, and Wonogiri were honored for innovation in tourism, smart city development, and industry.
